facts.fact: Eutelsat OneWeb operates commercially in South Africa through partners such as Paratus and Q-KON, per TechCentral commentary (article date used).

ICASA's notice gazetted 29 June 2026 says it cannot issue new I-ECNS network licences to LEO operators such as Starlink: no invitation to apply is open and a ministerial inquiry is running; entrants must buy an existing licence under ECA section 13.
Starlink is not licensed in South Africa: SpaceX has declined the 30% historically-disadvantaged-ownership requirement and a grey market persists.
